 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• This **method of gauging poverty **takes into account the fact that household food spending is a consistent fraction of overall consumption.
 
• The** poverty line** is fixed by multiplying the value of the basic food products by the reverse of the proportion that food expenditure signifies for total expenditure.
